Name: Demon Eye Fairy
Author: dirtsoilmulch
Description:
[center][size=5]ABOUT﻿[/size][/center]
This mod replaces the fairy companion with a demon eye from Terraria.
﻿Variations [u](which are dependent on the save file, but [b]can [/b]be edited)[/u] Include:
[list]
[*]Default Demon Eye
[*]Cataracts Demon Eye
[*]Sleepy Demon Eye
[*]2nd Phase Eye of Cthulhu
[*]Purple Demon Eye
[*]Green Demon Eye
[*]Spazmatism (1st Phase)
[*]Retinazer (2nd Phase)
[/list]
[center][size=5]HOW TO INSTALL
[/size][/center][list=1]
[*]Install the latest version of [url=http://https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2400]SMAPI[/url]﻿
[*]Install the latest version of [url=http://https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url]﻿
[*]Extract the file into your [i]\Stardew Valley\Mods[/i] folder
[*]Run the game using SMAPI 
[*]Enjoy!
[/list]

Manifest.Name: Demon Eye Fairy
Manifest.Description: Changes the fairy companion to assorted Demon Eyes from Terraria
Manifest.Author: dirtsoilmulch
